profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Viakoo, Inc.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Help design, coordinate, build, and deploy features across 3 distinct projects.
1) A Front End built in React (UX/UI Design along with addressing feature/product requirements)
2) A Back End built in Java/Spring boot (with some legacy groovy code) on top of a Postgres database
3) An Agent built in Java/Spring Boot that's deployed to customer sites and feeds data back to the cloud.

Occasionally I diagnose and QA complex bugs that present across all 3 projects when there is not an immediate indication of the source of the issue (for example a GUI feature not loading correctly because of a database corruption, or an API failing because of malformed data from an Agent)

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: Developing the web interface for operational intelligence software used in the management of physical security systems. Viakoo is an IoT company, focused on delivering analytics and failure detection for video surveillance and access control systems.

positions.title: Software Quality Engineer
positions.description: Manual and automated monitoring of the web service and phone app. Automated tests are written in Java and leverage Selenium to drive a Firefox browser.

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description:
Instructional Responsibilities: Taught Adventures in Robotics with Lego Mindstorm, Robotics Engineering with VEX, Movie Making with iMovie, and Digital Film Making with Final Cut Pro

Managerial Responsibilities: Helped manage morning check in and afternoon check out. Managed backups for one of the buildings. Offered advice and guidance to new instructors and spoke with concerned parents when needed.

projects.title: Wearable Tremor Sensor
projects.description: A novel device that can accurately and reliably gather movement data from patients with essential tremors. The sensor is packaged in a wearable finger ring, and is designed to measure and transmit acceleration data from a patient's hand to custom software created by Lift Labs Design on a nearby smartphone for analysis. Awarded the "Departmental Award" by faculty, staff, and students of the MAE department for superior design achievement.

projects.title: Mobile Inverted Pendulum
projects.description: Designed and programmed a control algorithm for balancing a robot with only two wheels, similar to a Segway. Used feedback from accelerometers and a gyroscope to determine the angle, and encoders attached to the wheels to measure speed and distance traveled. These were used as the inputs to the algorithm, which then determined the proper motor torque required to stabilize the system. Programming was done in C on the Beaglebone Black platform.
